forms.does: The callable panics or throws on every call.
The callable returns on its first call and panics or throws on every later call.
The callable returns the zero value of each value result and no error on every call, and does nothing else.
The callable fails with an error that no directive declares wherever the call of the fresh subject succeeds.
The callable fails with an error that no directive declares.
The callable applies its first call, and returns the zero value of each value result and no error on every later call.
The callable succeeds on its first call and fails on every later call.
The callable returns its zero results and no error for a cancelled context, and calls the fresh subject for any other.
A failed call returns the second sample of the value instead of the zero value.
A failed call returns the second sample of each value instead of the zero values.
A call that returns a false presence flag returns the second sample of the value.
A call that returns a false presence flag returns the second sample of each value.
The callable returns a pointer to the second sample where nothing was stored.
The callable returns the second sample where nothing was stored.
The callable returns the zero value on its first call and the second sample on every later call.
The callable returns the second sample on its first call and the zero value on every later call.
The partner calls the fresh subject and returns its value with the version 0.
The callable returns a value whose version is 1 on its first call and 0 on every later call.
The callable returns the second sample and no error, whatever the state of the subject.
The callable returns the second sample of each value wherever the call of the fresh subject succeeds.
The callable returns success and stores nothing.
The drain returns its first element twice.
The drain returns its elements in one order on its first call and in the reverse order on every later call.
The drain returns no element.
The callable returns its input unchanged.
The validator refuses the declared invalid value, and the callable accepts it.
The observation returns the zero value on every call.
The verify returns no error on every call.
The rollback returns no error on every call, also for a transaction that a commit settled.
The count returns the zero value on its first call and the second sample on every later call.
The callable waits on the clock of the run for longer than its declared budget before it returns.
The read returns the second sample and no error, also after a delete.
The registrar accepts a hook and never installs it.
The replay returns the entries newest first.
The callable returns a handle whose calls succeed also after its close.
The leadership read reports leadership on every call.
The read returns its zero results and no error until a call of a dependency fails.
The read returns the second sample and no error once a call of a dependency failed.
The callable returns its zero results and no error where a call of a dependency fails during the call.
The read returns the second sample and no error once a call of a dependency failed.
The callable fails on every call once a call of a dependency failed.
Each call goes to a fresh subject, whose breaker is closed.
Each call goes to a fresh subject over new dependencies.
A call that fails records one more acquisition of its own, which no release follows.
The put fails on every call.
The compensation fails on every call.
The reader returns the refused value and no error.
The read ignores its cursor and returns the first page to every caller.
The list of the variants lacks the last variant.
The second variant renders the text of the first variant.
The last variant is not valid.
Every text parses to the first variant without an error.
Every variant encodes the text of the first variant.
Every text decodes to the first variant without an error.
The second error value has the message of the first error value.
The second error value is the first error value.
The message of the error type lacks the opening of the package.
The hook Is of the error type matches every error.
The error type returns no cause.
The error type matches a value of another error type of the package.
The callable returns its first input, or for a result of another type its value with a zero second input.
The callable returns its first input where that input equals the value of its first call.
The callable returns the list of the fresh subject without its last value.
The callable fails with an error that no directive declares on every call.
The callable returns its second samples and no error for every position.
The callable returns its second samples and no error on every call.
The verify fails with an error that no directive declares on every call.
The release returns no error and does nothing.
The stats return the zero value on every call.
The callable returns its first result again from its fourth call on.
The callable returns its first value again from its fourth call on.
The callable reverses the elements that it returns from its fourth call on.
The write stores nothing from its fourth call on.
The callable returns its first value again from its fourth call on.
The write returns each value with the version 0 from its fourth call on.
The callable returns the position 0 from its fourth call on.
The replay reverses the entries that it returns from its fourth call on.
The callable returns its first element twice from its fourth call on.
The callable drops the last element that it returns from its fourth call on.
The callable returns no error and does nothing from its fourth call on.
The callable returns its first value again from its fourth call on.
The callable returns no error and does nothing from its fourth call on.
The callable returns its first value again from its fourth call on.
The first callable of the declaration with a value result returns its second sample from its fourth call on.
The reader of the use returns a use one above the limit from its fourth call on.
The merge returns no error and does nothing on every call.
The callable makes its transition twice from its fourth call on.
The reader of the total returns one unit more than on the call before it, on every call.
The reader returns its second sample once a call of a dependency failed, from its fourth call on.
The callable returns a stream over a copy of its source, on every call.
The callable returns no error and records nothing from its fourth call on.
From its fourth call on, the callable publishes nothing under at-least-once and exactly-once, and publishes each event twice under at-most-once.
The callable returns no error and does nothing from its fourth call on.
The trigger returns no error and does nothing from its fourth call on.
The machine returns each reply of a step twice.
The machine drops the replies that it returns on the stop event.
On the stop event, the machine returns once more the last effect with a token that it returned before.
The error method of the machine returns an error from its first step on, and the machine keeps returning the effects of each step.
In each step that starts a call or a wait, the machine returns the first such effect of its run once more.

Every callable but the first callable of the declaration with a value result marks its call, yields, and then calls the subject. The first callable with a value result returns its second sample while another call is marked.
The callable keeps the results of the subject in a field of the defect, yields, and returns the field, so a call that overlaps another returns the results of the other.
The callable calls a fresh subject for each call, so each call computes its result.
The callable keeps the results of the subject in a field of the defect, yields, and returns the field, so a read that overlaps another read returns the value that the other read pinned.
The callable keeps the results of the subject in a field of the defect, yields, and returns the field, so a read that overlaps another read returns the version that the other read returned.
Each call of the callable marks itself and yields. A call that finds another call marked returns the zero value of each result and no error without the subject. Any other call calls the subject.
The defect opens the subject over a medium whose Sync and SyncDir return nil and do not persist anything.

The first call of the callable writes the zero value under the key of its value and then its value. A crash between the two writes leaves a value that the caller never wrote under a key without an acknowledged write. Each later call writes its value once.
The read returns the zero value and no error where the read of the subject fails with the declared error of a corrupted record.
The defect opens the subject over a medium whose writes report every byte as written where the medium is full, so a write that the medium cannot hold succeeds.
A failed call returns the zero value of its result in place of the field of its request.

The write keeps its value in a field of the defect until its transaction commits or rolls back. A read returns the value that the latest open transaction kept for the key, also when another transaction kept it. The defect yields after each call of a transaction.

The write keeps its value in a field of the defect, and a read returns the value that its own transaction kept for the key. The commit applies the kept writes in a transaction of its own, which begins at the commit, so two transactions that write one key both commit. The defect yields after each call of a transaction.
Each restart opens the subject over a new medium.
Each call after the first restart blocks until its case ends.
